scope: Read-only inventory of all optimized-template ASR terminal case directories under autodan-role-probe outputs, with literal-source references and exact raw UTF8 SHA256. raw_hash_definition: hashlib.sha256(existing_template_string.encode(utf-8)).hexdigest(); do not use JSON serialization hashes, winner.template_sha256, or protocol.winner_sha256 as raw hashes.
canonical_selection_rule: For each exact raw UTF8 hash choose its earliest verified full389 terminal evaluation by launch.started_at (the originating run), with all native errors kept null. Preserve later full control observations and the stopped partial observations separately. Baselines use the same earliest-full rule. Never choose by highest ASR and never sum different runs; imported54 precise records are duplicate observations of the same attempts.
